svg.text: A fallback chain with a marker on every row, and no database anywhere
There is no persistence tier. What there is instead: four rungs of source data, a marker saying which rung served each row, and per-session state that a restart clears.
every row says which rung served it
Odoo never stops the app booting.
The last good sync, on disk. Used when
and it says that it is a cached answer.
real New Order Master export, built by

The scenario book and the journey seed.
Invented, and labelled invented, so no
reviewer mistakes one for the other.
R5's honesty marker: identity and history are marked separately, so a reviewer can tell what is real from what was invented — that distinction is the point of the chain.
Approvals, added and removed orders, the saved criteria default: each tester
gets their own slot, created on first touch. It is isolation, not authentication.
The id when no cookie is present —
must be told, not discover it.
infra/terraform/cloud_sql.tf exists and stays unapplied until the MVP needs it
the store is the fixtures and the migrated book
WHAT GETS WRITTEN, AND WHERE IT LANDS
The local record IS the record; PEAK's answer only decorates it. A transport or
mapping failure leaves the document UNSENT — re-sendable, and never lost.
who took the book out, and why
A manual adjustment is a local override carrying its provenance (R14)
read_state returns UNKNOWN rather than guessing (INT-05)
Three things this layer will not do for convenience
• A number's rung is part of the number. A screen that shows a SHEET figure beside an ODOO figure without saying so is wrong even when both are right.
• The chain degrades downward and says so at each step; it never silently substitutes. "Not configured" is an answer the interface is required to render.
• PEAK read-back is an open question (INT-05). Until it is confirmed, read_state answers UNKNOWN and the screen tells the officer to check PEAK — it does not invent a state.
